1 (Currently Amended): A regenerative braking control system for a __vehicle capable of operating on both electric power and traditional fuel__, comprising: at least one sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit a sensor signal responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor.

7 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to a selected one of __the__ front wheels and rear wheels of the vehicle.
